prompt:
Create a 2 minute 30 second instrumental cinematic ambient piece about light grazing a black hole. Around 52 BPM, C# minor. Bowed metal, low cello drones, stretched string harmonics and a sub that never becomes a beat. Time feels delayed; pitches lean as if gravity is tuning them. Solemn and dark-luminous, not horror. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no lyrics, no hummed melody-as-voice, no singing, no whispered speech. No sci-fi lasers, no abrupt impacts, no trailer drums, no brass fanfare.

[00:00–00:35] Almost static sub drone and one long cello tone, very quiet.
[00:35–01:10] Bowed metal harmonics drift sharp, then settle, like light on a curved path.
[01:10–01:50] Sparse piano notes fall slowly in pitch, never resolving fully.
[01:50–02:30] Texture thins toward the opening drone; a last harmonic hangs and fades.
